set.acceptance: A Go test of the stall cutoff: working at 19 minutes is not stalled, at 21 minutes is; blocked, usage-paused and exited sessions never are, and an idle one stalls only as run-session-idle-stall says; a testscript with a hand-written session record and RHIZA_TEST_NOW shows 'stalled' in run status only past the cutoff
set.statement: rhiza run status marks a live run-step session stalled as run-session-idle-stall says: once its hook status, working or idle, has gone unchanged for more than 20 minutes and it has not said `rhiza session done`, unless it is waiting on the arbiter's answer, paused for a usage limit, blocked or exited
